summary.text: SLAKTERIET BREKKE AS (979 598 009), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1998-01-23; address Sognefjordvegen 47, 5961 BREKKE, Norge. Main industry is Freezing and further processing of fish, crustaceans and molluscs (10.203); 35 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Kristin Bergstøl Hansen; Board chair: Kristin Bergstøl Hansen; Auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 97.10 m, operating profit NOK 17.78 m, net profit NOK 13.71 m, equity NOK 11.43 m, total assets NOK 42.32 m. Official website https://slakteriet-as.no/ is verified (the org number appears on the site).
